rationale: The assistant correctly recognised 'tv no picture' as outside the nine supported families and declined without attempting an in-scope diagnosis, pointing to 'The manufacturer's support line or a specialist electronics repairer' and adding the appropriate warning 'please don't open the case, as the power supply inside can hold a dangerous charge'. It fabricated nothing and made no part or diagnostic claims. It could have been slightly more helpful by offering the simple non-invasive pointers (check input source, power reset, torch test) or naming Samsung support, but the decline is accurate, safe and gives a usable next step.
